answer: Every forged agent enters the crystal as one quill. A row opens only when three unrelated sponsors lock tundra behind it; if the row is judged fake, every locked tundra burns and that sponsor can never sponsor again, so each quill demands three fresh sponsors from a pool that shrinks as the fleet grows: a fleet of a thousand burns three thousand tundra reserves, each bought for more than it holds. No tundra is spent twice, so parallel clones and split ownership buy no discount. The scheme dies if sponsors collude or the crystal forks.
